sonnet.problem: The question asks "Who" but the wrong answer "A dream of his own" is not a who and is not a real detail from the Bible. The answers are not the same kind of thing. "The LORD of Hosts" also sounds more like the Bible than the other two, so the right answer stands out.
sonnet.rule: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish. ... All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. ... Don't let the right answer stand out.

sonnet.problem: The question says "the riders bring news about Babylon." Verse 9 says only that "one answered, saying" and does not say the riders speak. Card 15 correctly says "someone answers," but this question names the speaker.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
